name: @jb9k62/good2go
description: Node tooling for OKF (Open Knowledge Format) bundles and agent memory: validator, graph viewer, Mermaid gates, ranked search, and the edukai memory bundle, plus skills and hooks for Claude Code and pi.
author: jb9k62

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && npm run typecheck -w okf-widgets
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run test:views && npm run g2g:validate && npm run edukai:validate
scripts.g2g:build-view: npm run build -w okf-widgets && node --import ./scripts/g2g-start.mjs src/g2g-build-view.mts build-view --widgets src/templates/okf-widgets/dist/okf-widgets.js
scripts.g2g:view: npm run build -w okf-widgets && node --import ./scripts/g2g-start.mjs src/g2g-build-view.mts open --widgets src/templates/okf-widgets/dist/okf-widgets.js
scripts.g2g:mermaid:render: npm run build -w okf-widgets && node --import ./scripts/g2g-start.mjs src/g2g-view.mts design --check-render --widgets src/templates/okf-widgets/dist/okf-widgets.js
scripts.edukai:validate: node --import ./scripts/g2g-start.mjs src/g2g-view.mts edukai --validate --strict && node --import ./scripts/g2g-start.mjs src/g2g-edukai.mts index --check
scripts.edukai:brief: node --import ./scripts/g2g-start.mjs src/g2g-edukai.mts index && node --import ./scripts/g2g-start.mjs src/g2g-hook.mts brief
scripts.demo: npm run build -w okf-widgets && node src/g2g-view.mts examples/demo/okf --widgets src/templates/okf-widgets/dist/okf-widgets.js
scripts.demo:edukai: npm run demo:edukai:brief && npm run demo:edukai:recheck
scripts.demo:edukai:brief: node src/g2g-edukai.mts index --bundle examples/demo/edukai --now 2026-10-15T00:00:00Z && node src/g2g-hook.mts brief --bundle examples/demo/edukai --now 2026-10-15T00:00:00Z
